//: ONE-SHOT seed job for QA/UAT. Reuses the API image because that is where the seed actually lives: prisma/seed.ts, the generated Prisma client, and ts-node (a devDependency the API Dockerfile deliberately keeps). A Railway Function or any bare runtime image cannot run this — it has no copy of the repository. THIS SERVICE EXISTS SO THE START COMMAND CAN BE OVERRIDDEN: a service with no config-as-code path falls back to the repository-root railway.json, which describes the API, so the seed service silently boots the API server instead (observed exactly that: 'ETicketsGo API listening on 0.0.0.0'). The compiler options are passed explicitly rather than using the package script, because the runtime image copies apps/api/prisma but NOT apps/api/tsconfig.json — ts-node then discovers some other tsconfig and dies with TS5109 (module NodeNext without a matching moduleResolution). Passing them inline makes the seed independent of whatever tsconfig happens to be reachable in the image. No healthcheckPath — a one-shot job serves nothing and would fail a health check. No preDeployCommand — migrations are the api service's job and must have exactly one executor. restartPolicyType NEVER is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: the full-reset operation empties every table, so a restart loop would repeatedly wipe the environment. Run it deliberately, never on a schedule, and NEVER point it at production. The entry point is prisma/seed-operation.ts, NOT prisma/seed.ts, and the difference matters: pointing this service straight at the seed meant that deploying it AT ALL emptied the database, including when someone deployed it intending to run something else. Because this file is config-as-code it OVERRIDES any start command set through the Railway API or dashboard — so 'just override the start command for one run' silently runs whatever is written here instead. That trap emptied QA once. The dispatcher closes it: the command never changes, an environment variable (which config-as-code does not override) selects the work, and the default with no variable set is a read-only census. SEED_OPERATION=status|india-cinema|full-reset; full-reset also requires SEED_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=yes.
